definitions.si_sdr_db: scale-invariant SDR computed by gtr-eval: both signals mono with their mean removed; target = (<est, ref>/<ref, ref>) * ref; SI-SDR = 10 log10(|target|^2 / |est - target|^2)
definitions.sdr_db: mir_eval.separation.bss_eval_sources(reference_sources, estimated_sources, compute_permutation=False) on mono signals (joint mode: all mapped stems in one call, so the other stems are the interference for SIR). Distortion filter length 512 taps (BSS Eval v3 as in mir_eval). sdr/sir/sar in dB
definitions.alignment: no time alignment is searched; the signals are compared sample by sample from the start of each file
